# shopify_metaobject_definition (Resource)

A metaobject definition and its fields. The `field` list is fully managed; other optional attributes left unset are not managed. Import with the definition `type`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shopify_metaobject_definition" "faq" {
  type             = "faq_entry"
  name             = "FAQ entry"
  display_name_key = "question"

  access = {
    storefront = "PUBLIC_READ"
  }

  capabilities = {
    publishable  = true
    translatable = true
  }

  field {
    key      = "question"
    name     = "Question"
    type     = "single_line_text_field"
    required = true
  }

  field {
    key  = "answer"
    name = "Answer"
    type = "rich_text_field"
  }

  # Removing fields, changing a field type or destroying deletes entry data; opt in explicitly when needed.
  allow_data_deletion = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `type` (String) Definition type, e.g. `faq_entry`. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `access` (Attributes) API access settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access))
- `allow_data_deletion` (Boolean) Allow destroying or replacing this metaobject definition or one of its fields, which deletes the data stored in it. Defaults to `false`. Must already be `true` in state when the delete runs, so set it in a separate apply first.
- `capabilities` (Attributes) Capabilities of entries of this type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capabilities))
- `description` (String) Description.
- `display_name_key` (String) Key of the field used as display name for entries.
- `field` (Block List) Field definitions, in display order. Removing a field or changing its `type` deletes its data and requires `allow_data_deletion = true`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--field))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Metaobject definition GID.

<a id="nestedatt--access"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access`

Optional:

- `admin` (String) `MERCHANT_READ` or `MERCHANT_READ_WRITE`. Null when Shopify reports a value that can't be set, e.g. the default `PUBLIC_READ_WRITE`.
- `customer_account` (String) `READ_WRITE`, `READ` or `NONE`.
- `storefront` (String) `PUBLIC_READ` or `NONE`.


<a id="nestedatt--capabilities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `capabilities`

Optional:

- `publishable` (Boolean) Entries have a draft/active status.
- `renderable` (Boolean) Entries can be rendered as web pages (SEO data).
- `translatable` (Boolean) Entries can be translated.


<a id="nestedblock--field"></a>
### Nested Schema for `field`

Required:

- `key` (String) Field key, unique within the definition.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `type` (String) Field type, e.g. `single_line_text_field`. Changing it deletes and recreates the field.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Description.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether entries must set this field. Defaults to `false`.
- `validations` (Map of String) Validation name to value, as for metafield definitions.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <type>
terraform import shopify_metaobject_definition.faq faq_entry
```
